title: Implement workspace dedupe in Python
description:
## Goal
Make the new workspace-deduplication Gherkin scenarios pass in the Python implementation (`python/`), on the read/listing path used by `kbs list` and similar read commands.

## Scope
- Implement deduplication of discovered issues keyed by issue identity, keeping the most recently changed version per the semantics fixed by the spec task.
- No fallback logic and no backward-compatibility paths (project policy): one correct approach.
- Do not change Virtuus; this is Kanbus application logic only.

## Done when
- behave scenarios for workspace deduplication pass.
- Distinct issues are never merged or dropped.
